# tracer

```go
import "gorontalo/pkg/tracer"
```

Package tracer captures runtime call\-stack information for debugging and error diagnostics.

The entry point is a plain package\-level function that takes a Config:

```
frames := tracer.Trace(tracer.Config{})
```

The zero\-value Config captures a sensible default stack. Set fields to tune it:

```
frames := tracer.Trace(tracer.Config{
	Skip:     3,
	MaxDepth: 10,
	Filter: func(f *runtime.Frame) bool {
		return strings.Contains(f.Function, "myapp")
	},
})
```

<a name="Config"></a>
## type [Config](<https://github.com/xwinata/gorontalo/blob/main/pkg/tracer/tracer.go#L41-L53>)

Config tunes Trace. The zero value is valid: Skip \<= 0 keeps the default \(skip Trace itself and runtime.Callers so the first frame is Trace's caller\), MaxDepth \<= 0 keeps the default cap, and a nil Filter captures every frame.

```go
type Config struct {
    // Skip is how many leading frames to skip. Values <= 0 keep the default.
    // Pass a positive value to skip additional frames (for example, from a
    // helper that wraps Trace).
    Skip int

    // MaxDepth caps the number of frames captured. Values <= 0 keep the
    // default.
    MaxDepth int

    // Filter, when non-nil, keeps only frames for which it returns true.
    Filter func(*runtime.Frame) bool
}
```

<a name="Frame"></a>
## type [Frame](<https://github.com/xwinata/gorontalo/blob/main/pkg/tracer/tracer.go#L23-L27>)

Frame is a single stack frame with its file, line, and function name.

```go
type Frame struct {
    File     string `json:"file"`
    Line     int    `json:"line"`
    Function string `json:"function"`
}
```

<a name="Trace"></a>
### func [Trace](<https://github.com/xwinata/gorontalo/blob/main/pkg/tracer/tracer.go#L75>)

```go
func Trace(cfg Config) []Frame
```

Trace captures the current call stack and returns the frames.

With a zero\-value Config it skips Trace itself and runtime.Callers \(so the first frame is the caller of Trace\), captures up to 32 frames, and includes every frame. Set Config.Skip, Config.MaxDepth, and Config.Filter to change this.

Each call operates on its own stack snapshot and is safe for concurrent use.
